title: DISTRICT PLAN ELEMENTS
previewText: All land in the open space network as shown on the District Plan (Map 3 in Appendix A), except public parks, and all zoning lots along an arterial as shown on the District Plan (Map 2 in Appendix A), are subject to the provisions of this Section, inclusive.
